purpose: Decide whether sourmash FracMinHash may be accepted as an admissible genome-distance source for the CABBAGE G8 effective-lineage gate, by requiring it to reproduce what Mash already measured on the committed provenance-disjoint cohorts.

derived_from.note: The bar is DERIVED from this table's own arithmetic. If the table changes, this bar is no longer a commitment about it -- the scorer re-checks this sha256 and refuses rather than scoring.

gate_source.note: Verdicts are computed THROUGH the imported gate, not restated. MIN_EFFECTIVE_LINEAGES is referenced, never copied.

clauses.name: verdict_identity
clauses.requirement: Every one of the 20 (cell, threshold) pairs must yield the same G8 verdict under sourmash clustering as under Mash.
clauses.why_weak: 19 of 20 pairs PASS with a median minority count of 14.0 against a bar of 3. Clause 1 (verdict identity) is therefore NECESSARY BUT NEARLY VACUOUS: a badly wrong clustering still reproduces most verdicts by margin alone. Clauses 2 and 3 are what actually discriminate. Do NOT report a high verdict-identity rate as evidence that sourmash agrees with Mash.

clauses.name: exact_minority_count_near_the_bar
clauses.requirement: On every pair whose Mash minority effective-lineage count is within +/-2 of the bar (3), the sourmash minority count must be EXACTLY equal to the Mash count.
clauses.note: Naming these pairs is not leaking future information: they are computed from Mash numbers committed long before this freeze, so pinning them pins against already-known data.

clauses.name: the_trip_must_reproduce
clauses.requirement: Every pair that Mash scores TRIP must also score TRIP under sourmash.
clauses.strength: DISCRIMINATING -- the single most important clause
clauses.why: A method that converts the project's only real negative into a PASS manufactures lineage diversity. That is the most dangerous possible direction of error, because it would license sourmash on CABBAGE and then report false lineage independence. A bar that cannot fail on its one real negative is theatre.

reported_not_gated.why: ARI and cluster-count were gate clauses in an earlier draft and are DEMOTED here with the reason recorded: ARI is unanchored to anything the G8 gate consumes, and a cluster-count tolerance binds only where verdict identity already binds harder. They are still emitted, so a reader can see HOW the partitions differ even when all clauses pass.

non_vacuity.why_this_matters: 19 of 20 pairs PASS with a median minority count of 14.0 against a bar of 3. Clause 1 (verdict identity) is therefore NECESSARY BUT NEARLY VACUOUS: a badly wrong clustering still reproduces most verdicts by margin alone. Clauses 2 and 3 are what actually discriminate. Do NOT report a high verdict-identity rate as evidence that sourmash agrees with Mash.

honest_limits: FracMinHash is not Mash's bottom-sketch MinHash, so agreement on these cohorts does not make the two estimators interchangeable in general.

The thresholds (0.001, 0.005) were calibrated against MASH distances. Passing this bar shows sourmash reproduces Mash's PARTITION VERDICTS at those thresholds on these cohorts; it does not re-derive the thresholds.
Clause 3 rests on a SINGLE TRIP pair. One negative is enough to make the bar non-vacuous and far too few to characterise sourmash's behaviour near the bar in general.
These are provenance-disjoint AMR cohorts, not CABBAGE. Accepting the distance source for CABBAGE is an extrapolation across cohorts.

clause_logic.discovered: 2026-10-19, while writing the scorer, BEFORE any agreement number existed
clause_logic.note: Clause 1 requires verdict identity on ALL pairs; clause 3 requires the TRIP pairs to reproduce TRIP. The second is a SUBSET of the first, so it adds no logical strength -- if the TRIP flips to PASS, clause 1 fails too. Clause 3 is RETAINED deliberately, as a SEVERITY and REPORTING pre-commitment: it names in advance which direction of failure matters most, and forces the result to state the TRIP outcome explicitly instead of burying it inside a '19/20 verdicts identical' aggregate.
clause_logic.why_this_is_recorded_rather_than_fixed: The three requirements are left EXACTLY as frozen. Rewriting a clause after noticing it is weaker than it looked would be bar-shopping even in the honest direction. This annotation only makes the bar sound weaker than its first reading, never stronger, and it is stamped before any number exists.
